children.name: Evidence
children.value: The blocks hold a new config block, which libwavpack has written since 5.0; libwavpack reports encoder version 5 for a file with one

findings.message: The set of blocks at 0xB46 holds 1 channel, but the first holds 2 channels.
The decorrelation weights sub-block at 0xB6E holds 10 bytes, but libwavpack takes a weight (two for stereo) for each of the 5 passes at most.
The entropy variables sub-block at 0xB84 holds 12 bytes, but libwavpack takes 6 bytes for a mono block.
